in_sanskrit.name: देवन
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: देव (Deva) + न (na) = देवन (Devan) Deva is a Sanskrit term for a god or deity. Na is a suffix which denotes 'belonging to'. Thus, Devan means 'belonging to a god' or 'godly'.

in_hindi.name: देवन
in_hindi.long_meaning: देव (Deva) = देवता (devata) वा यह पूज्य अर्थात् पूज्य ईश्वर या ईश्वर का साथी है। देवन वाला यह पूज्य अर्थ है। Deva in Hindi refers to a god or deity. Devan is a term used for someone who is devoted to a god or someone who is divine.

in_tamil.name: டேவன
in_tamil.long_meaning: டேவ (Deva) + ன (n) = டேவன (Devan) Deva in Tamil means 'god' or 'deity'. Devan is a term used for someone who is devoted to a god or someone who is divine.

in_telugu.name: దేవన
in_telugu.long_meaning: దేవ (Deva) + న (na) = దేవన (Devan) Deva in Telugu means 'god' or 'deity'. Devan is a term used for someone who is devoted to a god or someone who is divine.

in_marathi.name: Deven
in_marathi.long_meaning: Deven हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devan in Sanskrit and Hindi means 'God'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Deva' which refers to God or a divine being. In Hinduism, Deven is a popular name for baby boys, especially those who are believed to be blessed by Lord Shiva.
